definitions.explanation: A person who purchases something, especially in a commercial or formal context.

examples.japanese: {購入者|こうにゅうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
{購入者|こうにゅうしゃ}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are benefits exclusive to purchasers.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{購入者|こうにゅうしゃ}⟦レビュー→レビュー：11193_rebyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to buy after checking the purchaser reviews for this product.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧ (purchase) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Used in business, legal, and commercial contexts to refer to someone who has bought or is buying something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {購入者|こうにゅうしゃ}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧: purchaser-only; exclusive to buyers
- {購入者|こうにゅうしゃ}⟦レビュー→レビュー：11193_rebyuu⟧: buyer reviews
- {購入者|こうにゅうしゃ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: buyer information
- {購入者|こうにゅうしゃ}⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧: buyer bonus/perks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{買|か}い{手|て}→買い手：24770_kaite⟧: buyer — more general, often used in negotiations and real estate
- ⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧: consumer — broader term for someone who uses goods or services
- ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧: customer; client — focuses on the ongoing relationship rather than a single transaction
